    AI Overview
    As of April 2026, Rory McIlroy's net worth is estimated to be approximately $250 million to $330 million, driven by a career of consistent elite performance, massive endorsement deals, and strategic investments. He ranks second only to Tiger Woods in career PGA Tour earnings, surpassing $110 million on-course alone, withtotal earnings exceeding $190 million before 2026. 
    Key 2026 Net Worth Details: 
    • Total Wealth: Various estimates place his total fortune between $250 million and $330 million.
    • On-Course Earnings: Over $110 million in PGA Tour career earnings.
    • Endorsements: Long-term deals with partners like Nike, TaylorMade, Omega, and UnitedHealth Group bring in significant annual income.
    • Career Highlights: A four-time major champion and 2025 Masters champion, contributing to high endorsement and prize money.
    • Assets: He owns a $22 million mansion in Jupiter, Florida, among other properties. 
    McIlroy's income has transitioned from primarily on-course winnings to a balanced portfolio of tournament earnings and substantial off-course commercial ventures.

    AI Overview
    Rory McIlroy owns an extensive international property portfolio, with his primary residence being a roughly $22 million-$24 million mansion in Jupiter, Florida. He also owns or has owned properties in California, a New York City apartment, a villa in Dubai, a home in Northern Ireland, and is developing a new residence in England. 
    Key Properties in McIlroy’s Portfolio: 
    • Jupiter, Florida (Primary): Located in the exclusive Bear's Club, this mansion features a swimming pool, tennis court, and a state-of-the-art gym.
    • England (Surrey): A custom-built home near London (Wentworth) that the family began using in 2025
      .
    • La Quinta, California: A large home owned by the golfer.
    • New York City: An apartment.
    • Dubai: A villa on the Palm Jumeirah.
    • Northern Ireland: Formerly owned a mansion in County Down. 
    As of early 2026, he continues to hold several of these properties while spending time between Florida and the UK.
